name: Windows, Autopilot & Intune
description: Windows 11 and Insider builds, Windows AI features, Windows Autopilot and Microsoft Intune.

items.title: Microsoft confirms Windows updates can leave SQL Server linked-server connections open
items.summary: Microsoft confirmed that Windows updates released October 13, 2026, and later can leave some SQL Server linked-server connections open after queries finish. The connections can accumulate and degrade performance over time; Microsoft says an out-of-band update is planned.

items.title: Microsoft details two-phase NTLM signing security improvements for Windows
items.summary: Microsoft says Windows updates from November 10, 2026, begin the first phase of NTLM signing improvements addressing CVE-2026-118737: clients offer signing by default on non-anonymous connections, with auditing to identify connections not using it. A second phase planned for May 2027 will make Windows servers require signing by default, giving administrators a timeline to assess compatibility and prepare.

items.title: Windows 11 23H2 Enterprise and Education reach end of updates
items.summary: Microsoft says Windows 11 version 23H2 Enterprise and Education reached end of updates on November 10, 2026. The November security update is the last available for those editions, so eligible devices need to move to a supported Windows 11 version to continue receiving monthly security and quality updates.

items.title: Microsoft releases November security updates for supported Windows 11 versions
items.summary: Microsoft published its November 10 cumulative security updates for Windows 11, including KB5132061 for 26H2, 25H2, and 24H2 Enterprise/Education; KB5132059 for 26H1; and KB5131087 for 23H2. The updates include security fixes and quality improvements, including stronger default NTLM signing for non-anonymous connections on versions covered by KB5132061.

items.title: Adobe and Microsoft expand creative apps and Adobe Express integration on Windows
items.summary: Adobe and Microsoft announced optimized versions of several Adobe creative apps for high-performance Arm-based Windows PCs. Adobe Express tools and templates are also coming to Microsoft Photos on Windows 11, with a Windows Insider preview starting in December.

items.title: Investigation reports a 30-minute app-preparation delay in one Autopilot deployment
items.summary: A Patch My PC investigation published November 10 reports that MDMWinsOverGP policy processing coincided with a roughly 30-minute delay before apps were prepared in one Autopilot self-deployment using Shared PC settings. The author says excluding the implicated Autopatch profile resolved that case; this is a third-party finding, not a Microsoft-confirmed general issue or official fix.
items.company: Microsoft (Windows Autopilot, Intune and Windows Autopatch); Patch My PC

items.title: Microsoft releases five Windows 11 Insider builds with Search, privacy and Windows Hello updates
items.summary: Microsoft announced five Windows 11 Insider preview builds across Beta and Experimental channels, including builds for 26H1 and Future Platforms. Notable changes include a redesigned Windows Search with inline actions, per-app desktop camera/microphone/location permissions, and Windows Hello sign-in and facial-recognition brightness improvements.

items.title: Report: Windows 11 27H2 may be a major OS update as Microsoft sticks with Windows 11
items.summary: The Verge reports, citing sources, that Microsoft is preparing Windows 11 version 27H2 for 2027 as a full OS swap, with a focus on quality. The report says it remains unclear whether Microsoft will use Windows 12 branding; Microsoft has not confirmed the reported plans.

items.title: Microsoft outlines AI-era Windows vulnerability management and faster remediation
items.summary: Microsoft describes expanding AI-assisted vulnerability discovery and using AI to help engineers assess impact, identify affected Windows versions, and develop remediation and backport strategies. It also highlights Windows Autopatch through Intune, staged deployments, and hotpatching as ways to reduce the time and disruption involved in deploying protections.

items.title: Microsoft details local coding-AI advances for Windows PCs
items.summary: Microsoft describes how low-bit quantization and systems optimizations make its MAI-Code-1.1-Flash model more practical for local coding workloads on Windows PCs. The post says the 53.0 GiB checkpoint is available through Microsoft Foundry and as a local model in GitHub Copilot on RTX Spark, enabling coding tasks to run on-device rather than relying entirely on per-token cloud usage.

items.title: Microsoft details Windows 11 performance and memory improvements for 8 GB PCs
items.summary: Microsoft says Windows 11 has memory and performance improvements for 8 GB PCs, reporting up to 20% greater responsiveness and up to 40% faster multitasking in a lab test. The changes include reduced memory use for idle experiences; Microsoft says the latest improvements require Windows 11 version 26H2, build 26300.9818 or later, and notes that actual results and rollout timing may vary.

items.title: Report: leaked Microsoft roadmap outlines four tiers of Windows AI hardware
items.summary: Windows Central reported that slides attributed to Microsoft outline four tiers of Windows AI hardware, spanning consumer PCs to systems intended for demanding local AI workloads. The roadmap reportedly combines local processing with cloud AI, but the information comes from slides shared by an X user and is not a confirmed Microsoft announcement.

items.title: Microsoft announces new Windows 11 Insider builds and private Feedback Hub policy
items.summary: Microsoft released new Windows 11 Insider builds to the Beta and Experimental channels and introduced an Intune policy that can keep tenant users’ Feedback Hub submissions private. The accompanying previews include expanded Windows Search actions and, in a Future Platforms build, app-by-app camera, microphone, and location permissions for desktop apps.

items.title: Microsoft Intune October updates add security baselines, EPM network controls, and Autopatch scheduling
items.summary: Microsoft’s October Intune updates add a Windows 365 for Agents security baseline and let standard users make IT-approved network-setting changes through Endpoint Privilege Management without broad admin rights. Windows Autopatch also gains expanded approval and scheduling controls for quality updates, including independent management of different update types.

items.title: Microsoft updates KB5127936 notes with modernized AutoPlay details and a Windows 11 24H2 update clarification
items.summary: Microsoft’s KB5127936 notes were updated on October 29 to detail a modernized AutoPlay experience, including dark mode, improved text scaling, and notifications in Notification Center. The notes also clarify that Windows 11 24H2 no longer receives non-security preview updates starting with the October 2026 release; Enterprise and Education editions continue to receive monthly security updates.

items.title: Microsoft Edge adds accelerated app launches on Windows 11
items.summary: Microsoft announced that Edge is the first browser to support Windows accelerated app launches, with a stated 15% launch-speed improvement for most users and up to 33% under heavy multitasking. The capability is supported with Edge 150 or later on Windows 11 versions 25H2, 26H2, and 26H1 when KB5127936 or a later update is installed.

items.title: Windows 11 26H1 preview adds WinRE remote-management support for MDM providers
items.summary: Microsoft’s October 28 preview update KB5127653 for Windows 11 version 26H1 adds a recovery remote-management plug-in that extends Windows Recovery Environment management capabilities for MDM providers. The update also includes other Windows improvements, but this new MDM recovery capability is the notable endpoint-management change.

items.title: Microsoft confirms removal of seven eMudhra certificates from Edge trust list
items.summary: Microsoft updated its eMudhra response to confirm that it removed the seven affected certificates from the Microsoft Edge trust list on October 27. The update also explains the impersonation and malicious-code-signing risks and warns organizations to assess carefully before restoring local trust.

items.title: Microsoft releases KB5134133 certificate trust update for Windows 11 24H2–26H2
items.summary: Microsoft published KB5134133, a cumulative non-security out-of-band update for Windows 11 versions 24H2, 25H2, and 26H2. It is intended for devices that do not receive current certificate trust list updates, such as disconnected devices or devices unable to access Microsoft’s certificate-update service.

items.title: Microsoft publishes its October 2026 security update release, including Windows updates
items.summary: Microsoft’s Security Update Guide lists its October 2026 security release as released on October 26 and includes cumulative updates for Windows. The release page reports 1,105 Windows vulnerabilities addressed and flags a Windows Shell security feature bypass vulnerability with exploitation detected.
